name: moringa-project
description: Moringa e-commerce platform - AdonisJS + Fastify backend + Qwik City frontend

scripts.install:all: cd adonis-backend-new && npm install && cd ../next-Frontend-new && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd adonis-backend-new && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd adonis-backend-new && npx prisma db seed
scripts.build: cd adonis-backend-new && npm run build && cd ../next-Frontend-new && npm run build
